name: Kingdom of Aldenmoor
description: The ruling monarchy of the northern reaches. Disciplined, proud, and increasingly desperate as the old magic fades.

name: The Ironveil Syndicate
description: A ruthless merchant guild that has quietly purchased half the continent's debt. Loyalty is a commodity — everything has a price.

name: The Wandering Circle
description: Nomadic druids and lorekeepers who owe allegiance to no crown. They remember what the world was before the first kingdoms rose.

name: Ashborne Remnants
description: Survivors of a razed city who have embraced shadow magic in their pursuit of revenge. Their cause was just once; few still believe that.
